general.description:
This station, named for Sara Seynberg, the human xenoethnologist who publicly revealed the presence of Adrimai on Irilia-17 at the ties of the Fringe Wars and sparkled a major part of the Adrimai freedom movement, was built to become a major Free Adrimai base.
It has since become a gathering point for the Adrimai seeking to flee the Rith Sphere and the start of the exfiltration routes to Pupeteer space.
